abstract: CDX-2 is a caudal-type homeobox gene, encoding a transcription factor that plays an important role in proliferation and differentiation of intestinal epithelial cells. The utility of antibodies to CDX2 in the identification of adenocarcinomas of the gastrointestinal tract, particularly colorectal adenocarcinomas, in both primary and metastatic settings is well established. It is well-known that patients with testicular tumors may occasionally lack an obvious palpable mass. However, the expression of CDX2 in malignant germ cell tumors of the testes which have metastatic potential has not been previously studied in a large series. A tissue microarray was constructed from 52 malignant germ cell tumors of the testes including: 29 cases of classic seminoma, 8 cases of embryonal carcinoma, 8 cases of yolk sac tumor, 4 cases of malignant teratoma, 2 cases of choriocarcinoma, and 1 case of spermatocytic seminoma. Ten cases of intratubular germ cell neoplasia and seven cases of benign testicles with normal seminiferous tubules were also included in tissue microarray. Immunohistochemical stains for CDX2 was performed and analyzed. Only nuclear staining was considered positive. Positive expression of CDX2 was identified in 2/2 cases (100 %) of choriocarcinoma, 4/8 cases (50 %) of teratoma, 3/8 cases (38 %) of embryonal carcinoma, 3/8 cases (38 %) of yolk sac tumor, and 1/29 cases (3 %) of classic seminoma. CDX2 was negative in all cases of intratubular germ cell neoplasia, normal seminiferous tubules, and the only case of spermatocytic seminoma. The role of CDX-2 in the differentiation of intestinal/enteric epithelial cells may contribute to the formation of trophoblastic, glandular, villous, or cystic structures in germ cell tumors of the testes. This study suggests that the expression of CDX2 in a variety of malignant germ cell tumors of the testes may be a potential pitfall in metastatic tumors of unknown primary, which are thought to be of gastrointestinal/colorectal origin but are actually from a clinically occult testicular tumor.
abstract_ja: CDX-2は尾側型ホメオボックス遺伝子であり、腸上皮細胞の増殖と分化において重要な役割を果たす転写因子をコードする。消化管、特に大腸腺癌の原発巣および転移巣の同定における抗CDX2抗体の有用性は確立されている。精巣腫瘍の患者は、明らかな触知可能な腫瘤を欠くことがしばしばある。しかし、転移能を有する悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるCDX2の発現は、大規模な症例で検討されたことがない。52例の悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍(古典的セミノーマ29例、胎児性癌8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍8例、悪性奇形腫4例、絨毛癌2例、精母細胞性セミノーマ1例)からなる組織マイクロアレイを作製した。精細管内胚細胞腫瘍10例および正常精細管を有する良性精巣7例も組織マイクロアレイに含めた。CDX2の免疫組織化学染色を実施し、解析した。核染色のみを陽性とした。CDX2陽性は、絨毛癌2/2例(100%)、奇形腫4/8例(50%)、胎児性癌3/8例(38%)、卵黄嚢腫瘍3/8例(38%)、古典的セミノーマ1/29例(3%)で認められた。CDX2は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、正常精細管、および精母細胞性セミノーマの唯一の症例では全例陰性であった。消化管/腸管上皮細胞の分化におけるCDX-2の役割は、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍における栄養膜様、腺様、絨毛様、あるいは嚢胞性構造の形成に寄与している可能性がある。精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の多様な組織型におけるCDX2の発現は、原発不明癌の転移巣において落とし穴となりうる。原発不明癌は消化管/大腸由来と考えられているが、実際には臨床的に潜在性の精巣腫瘍に由来するものであり得る。
